name: Memo-Prime
headline: Memo-Prime
description: Helps improve memory and concentration, supporting more effective mental work.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule a day with food, morning or midday. Course: 1 month.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Memophenol (French grape and wild Canadian blueberry extract) 300 mg, green tea extract 50 mg, vitamin B12 (methylcobalamin) 3 mcg, zinc 2.3 mg, vitamin B6 (pyridoxal 5-phosphate) 2 mg, vitamin B9 (calcium L-methylfolate Extrafolate-S) 100 mcg, excipients.
